ShortDescription.Value: Advanced Transit Operations (ATO) is a public transit dispatch mod for Cities: Skylines II.

Publish.LongDescription:
Advanced Transit Operations (ATO) is a public transit dispatch mod for Cities: Skylines II.
If you are tired of controlling public transit only with sliders, or if you want more precise control over when a line departs, how Rapid and Local services operate, and what broadcasts play on vehicles and platforms, ATO gives your public transit system more operational possibilities.
The current version supports Train, Subway, Tram, and Bus. Supported languages: English, Simplified Chinese, and Japanese.
## 🚋🚌 The wait is over!
This update adds support for trams and buses, bringing ATO’s scheduling, timetables, broadcast system, and other features to more types of public transport.
Whether it’s trams running through city streets or buses handling everyday local service, they can now be managed within the same operations system.
Please refer to the Update History for the complete changelog.
## Core Gameplay
### Operate Lines with Your Own Timetables
Assign specific departure times to each Train, Subway, Tram, or Bus line, with separate timetables for peak, off-peak, and final services.
### Run Passing Operations
Configure Rapid and Local lines along the same corridor, then choose which stations can be used for passing operations. When a rapid train catches up with a local train ahead, ATO will have the local train wait at a Bypass Station for the rapid train to pass.
### Create Broadcasts for Your City
Import your own audio files and create automatically triggered broadcasts for vehicles and platforms. Use dynamic station names and multilingual audio to create a distinctive announcement system for your city.
### Observe Real Passenger Flow
ATO records actual boardings, alightings, section loads, and completed OD data, helping you adjust service frequency, Rapid and Local stopping patterns, and line layouts based on actual operating results.
## Gameplay Guide
For the complete gameplay guide, interface instructions, recommended line layouts, detailed configuration steps, and frequently asked questions, please visit GitHub:
GitHub Gameplay Guide: https://github.com/huasyl/AdvancedTransitOperations/blob/main/docs/player-guide.en-US.md
ATO has two in-game interfaces. Left-click the mod button in the upper-right corner to open the Workbench panel, and right-click it to open the Selection panel.
## Before You Start
After the first load or a line structure change, ATO needs to collect running data again, and dispatch may take several in-game hours to stabilize.
Lines built with bidirectional single-track railway sections are currently not supported, but depot access tracks and junction areas in front of stations are not affected.
## Compatibility & Save Safety
This mod does not use Harmony.
- **Xtended Transport Manager (XTM):** Full compatibility has been implemented. After using Set first stop, ATO will collect updated running data for the line, and dispatch may take some time to stabilize again.
- **Traffic Tool Essentials:** Its Depot Zone conflicts with ATO’s Depot Selection feature because both affect depot assignment. Please enable only one of these two features. Other features can coexist.
- **FastBoarding:** Can coexist, but using rail fast boarding or late-passenger skipping on rail lines controlled by ATO is not recommended.
- **Realistic Trips:** Compatible and can be used together with ATO.
- **All Aboard!:** Incompatible. All Aboard! replaces the vanilla public transport vehicle systems that ATO relies on.
Other mods that automatically adjust vehicle count, departure intervals, boarding speed, the game’s time flow, or the public transport vehicle lifecycle may also cause conflicts. Please refer to GitHub for complete compatibility details.
ATO writes only its own configuration and runtime data into the save file and does not permanently modify vanilla line, station, or vehicle assets. If the mod is disabled or removed, vanilla public transport will continue to run according to the game’s own logic. Backing up important saves is still recommended.
ATO is still in beta. If you encounter an issue, or have any feedback or suggestions, you are welcome to report it on the forum or GitHub:
GitHub: https://github.com/huasyl/AdvancedTransitOperations
If you find ATO fun or helpful for operating your public transport network, please consider giving the mod a like. Thank you for playing and supporting ATO!
**———————— 中文版 / CHINESE VERSION ————————**
Advanced Transit Operations（ATO）是面向《城市：天际线 2》公共交通运营的调度 Mod。
如果您已经厌倦了只靠车辆数量和间隔滑块控制公共交通，或者希望更精确地安排线路发车时间、设计快慢车运营方案、制作车辆和站台广播，ATO 可以为您的公共交通系统提供更多运营可能。
当前支持火车、地铁、有轨电车和公交。支持语言：英语、简体中文、日语。
## 🚋🚌 久等了！
此次更新加入了对有轨电车和公交的支持，ATO 现在可以将调度、时刻表、广播等功能应用到更多类型的公共交通线路。
无论是穿行于城市街道的有轨电车，还是承担日常接驳的公交线路，现在都可以纳入同一套运营体系。
完整内容请参阅更新历史。
## 核心玩法
### 按自己的时刻表运营线路
为火车、地铁、有轨电车和公交线路安排具体发车时刻，并分别设置高峰、平峰和末班服务。
### 开行快车、慢车与越行服务
为同一走廊设置快线、普通线和待避站。当快车追上前方慢车时，ATO 会让慢车在待避站等待快车通过。
### 制作属于自己城市的广播
导入自己的音频，为车辆和站台设置自动触发的广播，并通过动态站名和多语言音频制作具有城市特色的报站系统。
### 观测真实客流
ATO 会记录实际乘降、区间载客量和已完成 OD 数据，帮助您根据真实运营结果调整班次、快慢车停站方案和线路结构。
## 游玩指引
完整游玩指引、界面说明、线路搭建方式、详细配置方法及常见问题请参阅 GitHub：
GitHub 游玩指引：https://github.com/huasyl/AdvancedTransitOperations/blob/main/docs/player-guide.zh-CN.md
ATO 有两个界面。左键单击游戏右上角的 Mod 按钮打开工作台面板，右键单击打开选择面板。
## 使用前须知
第一次载入或线路结构发生变化后，ATO 需要重新收集运行数据，调度可能需要几个游戏小时逐步稳定。
目前不支持使用单线双向铁路区间构建的线路，但出入库线和站前分岔区域不受此限制。
## 兼容性与存档安全
本 Mod 未使用 Harmony。
- **Xtended Transport Manager（XTM）：** 已实现全面兼容。使用“设置首站”后，ATO 会重新观测线路运行数据，调度可能需要一点时间重新稳定。
- **Traffic Tool Essentials：** 其 Depot Zone 功能与 ATO 的车库选择功能会同时影响车库分配，建议只启用其中一个；其他功能可以共存。
- **FastBoarding：** 可以共存，但不建议在 ATO 接管的轨道线路上启用轨道快速上客或跳过迟到乘客。
- **Realistic Trips：** 已实现兼容，可以共同使用。
- **All Aboard!：** 不兼容。该 Mod 会替换 ATO 所依赖的原版公共交通车辆运行系统。
自动调整车辆数、发车间隔、上客速度、游戏时间流速或车辆运行流程的其他 Mod 也可能产生冲突。完整兼容说明请参阅 GitHub。
ATO 只向存档写入自身的配置和运行数据，不会永久修改原版线路、车站或车辆资产。关闭或移除后，公共交通仍会按照游戏自身的逻辑运行。重要存档仍建议提前备份。
ATO 目前仍处于 Beta 阶段。如果您遇到问题，或有任何意见和建议，欢迎通过论坛或 GitHub 反馈：
GitHub：https://github.com/huasyl/AdvancedTransitOperations
如果您觉得 ATO 好玩，或者它对您的公共交通运营有所帮助，欢迎为本 Mod 点个赞。感谢您的游玩与支持！
